上传状态：完整 Full-Danbooru-Complement-20260518 和2026-05-19至2026-06-30的数据已经整理并上传完毕。

Full Danbooru Complement 是一个面向 Danbooru 图像数据的补全数据集。当前发布的 Full-Danbooru-Complement-20260518 版本用于补充 DeepGHS 团队发布的 deepghs/danbooru2024-webp-4Mpixel 之后的 Danbooru 图像记录，便于把 Danbooru2024 基线数据继续延伸到 2026-05-18 附近的快照状态。
本补全版本的 post metadata 与补全依据来自 u-haru/danbooru-tags-20260518。图像按记录重新获取、整理并以 WebP 存储在 Parquet 行内：编码质量为 95，最长边限制为 2048。这份数据集并非Danbooru全站归档，准确地说是对于… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Xuness/Full-Danbooru-Complement.

removed_datasets.description:
Arena Messages Collection
	

A Arena (the AI leaderboard) website messages collection. This dataset may include typos. But we keep the original rows. Designed for pretraining and/or finetuning AI models and NLP.

If you have a GPU, you can train a model on this!
A collection of a lot of prompts and responses from Arena (previously LMArena, previously before LMArena, LMSYS)
Note: This dataset contains typos and toxic content. But toxic content is pretty little.
